patch.content:
find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS ${ZEPHYR_BASE})
project(heap_kasan_test)

if(CONFIG_SYS_HEAP_KASAN_MALLOC)
  target_sources(app PRIVATE src/main.c)
else()
  # This test suite requires CONFIG_SYS_HEAP_KASAN_MALLOC to be enabled.
  # If it's not enabled (e.g., due to NATIVE_LIBC), we skip compiling
  # the test sources to avoid compilation errors.
  message(STATUS "Skipping compilation of tests/lib/heap_kasan/src/main.c because CONFIG_SYS_HEAP_KASAN_MALLOC is not enabled.")
endif()
